title: Local transcription to word JSON
what_it_does: Turns a recording into a word-timed JSON ({words:[{w,start,end}], language, engine}) on this machine with HyperFrames' own whisper.cpp engine; free, no account, Turkish and English tested. It moves words that whisper timed inside a pause back to where the sound is.
when_to_use: First step for any recording of a person talking, before silence-cut, captions or shorts. Not for speech over loud music (use --model medium) and not when the person asked for a paid, more accurate engine.
needs: hyperframes (the studio's pinned binary; it fetches whisper.cpp and the model on first use)
notes: Wraps `hyperframes transcribe --engine whisper` (HyperFrames, Apache-2.0); no HyperFrames code is copied. First run downloads the runtime and the ~470 MB 'small' model (about 6 minutes on a home connection); later runs of 'small' take about 1/5 of the audio length on an M1. End-to-end proof: catalog/lanes/talking-head/example/run-proof.sh.
